exact_match.definition: Same manufacturer brand and model number, character for character.
exact_match.target: Match the lowest eligible exact-match price.
exact_match.model_number_suffix: A differing year or revision suffix is a near-miss, never a match.

comparable_match.definition: Different product, similar specification and intended use.
comparable_match.target_note: Recommend a price within 5% of the lowest eligible comparable price.

constraints.min_change_note: Below this, recommend hold — not worth a price change.

rounding.house_brand: Round to the nearest whole dollar, ending .00
rounding.rule: Round in the direction that protects margin.

price_field_note: Never use member_price — it is not available to every shopper.
